title: Show HN: Microsoft releases Flint, a visualization language for AI agents
summary: Microsoft Flint is a specialized visualization language designed specifically for AI agents to reliably generate high-quality data visualizations, addressing the inherent trade-off between simplicity (low quality charts) and complexity (verbose, unreliable specs) in existing approaches.
problem_solved: Solves the challenge of building AI agents that can consistently generate professional data visualizations without the current trade-off between simplicity and complexity.
why_valuable: It enables AI agents to reliably produce publication-quality charts by redesigning the visualization language itself rather than relying on improved AI capabilities alone.
